comment: Published catalogue values of the Mazak VC-Ez 20 (Mazak Corporation product page 'VC-Ez 20', mazak.com/us-en/detail/usa/vertical/us-vcez20zk/): travels 41.34 x 20.08 x 25 in (1050 x 510 x 635 mm), 12000 rpm, 18 kW (25 hp, 5 min rating), 30 tools, CAT No. 40; the series page ('Vertical Machining Centers VC-Ez') gives MAZATROL SmoothEz as standard and SmoothG as an option. Whether the control runs EIA/ISO programs is not stated there: check the control's options. Rapids, cutting feed, torque, tool change time, acceleration and rigid tapping are not stated there: 0 / false = unknown. Axis directions are not stated; travels are given from 0. Not verified on a real machine.
name: Generic Mazak VMC, EIA/ISO programs (VC-Ez 20 class)
